objects.name: Linked hosting clusters and the purchase batches behind them: technical analysis
objects.description: Public warning lists carry more than 1,800 shop-style domain names that point at one hosting network. A list says a name is bad; it does not say which names belong together. NSS read the public registration record of every name and found that 1,770 of them were bought in 98 batches, each batch within seconds, and that those batches tie nine hosts in six address blocks into three groups. This paper sets out what was measured, what it does and does not prove, and what a defender can look for.
